content: Arcot Nawab Muhammad Ali Wallaja (Walla) in Arani Coin with Hanuman figure.This Walla coin of Arani will be issued after the victory of Arani War in 1751 against Raju Sahib (Chanda Sahib’s son along with French forces).After this victory Arani was under the control of Arcot Nawab.This Hanuman Variety coin is first issued by Arani Maratha with Front side of coin with Hanuman and Backside of coin with Venkatarao written in Nagari Legend.
